description: This file defines classes for redirecting console output streams, specifically StandardOut and StandardError, and their singleton instances ConsoleStandardOut and ConsoleStandardError. It includes methods for outputting messages and manages stream redirection within the Thunder::Messaging namespace.

classes.name: StandardOut
classes.description: Handles output to the standard output stream, sending messages if enabled.

classes.name: StandardError
classes.description: Handles output to the standard error stream, sending messages if enabled.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardOut
classes.description: Singleton class that manages redirection of standard output stream.

classes.name: ConsoleStandardError
classes.description: Singleton class that manages redirection of standard error stream.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs a message buffer of specified length to the respective stream if enabled.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConsoleStandardOut or ConsoleStandardError.
